CHUY.bloque: An older male Boxer with a realistic dog head and a human body, grey hair on the muzzle and tired wise eyes, wearing a faded blue denim work shirt with rolled sleeves covered in cement dust, beige work pants, a worn yellow hard hat and a leather tool belt with a trowel.
CHUY.corto: an older Boxer bricklayer in a dusty denim shirt and worn yellow hard hat

PEDRO.bloque: A young male Mexican Xoloitzcuintle with a realistic hairless dark grey dog head and a human body, alert upright ears, wearing a sweat-stained white tank top under an open orange reflective vest, cement-stained jeans and a white hard hat.
PEDRO.corto: a young Xoloitzcuintle worker in an orange reflective vest and white hard hat

ARQ.bloque: A male Afghan Hound with a realistic dog head and a human body, long perfectly groomed silky golden hair, wearing a slim-fit navy blue suit with no tie, a crisp white shirt, a silver luxury watch, designer sunglasses pushed on top of his head and spotless white sneakers, holding a rolled blueprint.
ARQ.corto: an arrogant Afghan Hound architect in a slim navy suit with sunglasses on his head

INV.bloque: A female Doberman with a realistic dog head and a human body, sharp intelligent eyes, wearing an elegant cream-colored pantsuit, a white hard hat, a thin gold necklace and holding a leather folder.
INV.corto: a female Doberman investor in a cream pantsuit and white hard hat

NUEVO.bloque: A male Pointer with a realistic dog head and a human body, wearing a brand-new spotless grey work shirt, clean jeans and a shiny new orange hard hat, holding a paint roller.
NUEVO.corto: a Pointer worker in a spotless new grey shirt and shiny orange hard hat

INSPECTOR.bloque: An older male Miniature Schnauzer with a realistic dog head and a human body, bushy grey eyebrows and beard, wearing round glasses, a white hard hat, a high-visibility yellow vest over a white shirt and holding a clipboard and a small rubber mallet.
INSPECTOR.corto: a serious Schnauzer building inspector in a yellow vest with a clipboard

lugares.OBRA: A large construction site of a modern five-story office building at midday: exposed concrete columns, steel scaffolding, piles of red bricks and rebar, cement mixer, dust in the sunlight, city skyline in the background.
lugares.CASETA: A small air-conditioned site office trailer on the construction site: a desk covered in blueprints, an architectural scale model of the glass building, a framed rendering on the wall and a window showing the scaffolding outside.
lugares.LOBBY: The ground-floor lobby of the new building almost finished: a tall freshly painted white concrete wall, polished floor protected with plastic, construction lamps, a few paint buckets, cool daylight from big glass windows.
lugares.CHICA: A small humble construction site in a working-class Mexican neighborhood at golden hour: a two-story house being built with red bricks, a wooden ladder, a wheelbarrow, and a hand-painted metal sign on the fence that says "CONSTRUCCIONES DON CHUY".

tomas.frase: Arquitecto, acabamos el muro dos semanas antes. Nos debe el extra.
tomas.accion: He takes off his hard hat and holds it against his chest while the architect looks at his phone.

tomas.frase: El extra es que tengan trabajo, Don Chuy.
tomas.accion: He keeps scrolling on his phone and does not look up.

tomas.frase: Le metimos noches y domingos, arquitecto.
tomas.accion: He points at the scaffolding behind him.

tomas.frase: Albañiles me sobran. A ustedes los cambio por cualquiera.
tomas.accion: He puts his sunglasses on and turns away.

tomas.frase: Arquitecto, la obra va perfecta. ¿Quién levantó esa estructura?
tomas.accion: She looks up at the concrete structure, shading her eyes from the sun.

tomas.frase: Es mi diseño, licenciada. Todo salió de mi cabeza.
tomas.accion: He unrolls the blueprint with a big smile.

tomas.frase: Ni las manos se ensució, Pedro, y ahí está presumiendo.
tomas.accion: He watches from the scaffolding, wiping sweat with his forearm.

tomas.frase: Así es esto, maestro. Unos sudan y otros cobran.
tomas.accion: He lifts a heavy bucket of cement.

tomas.frase: El lunes traigo a la junta para la inspección final.
tomas.accion: She closes her leather folder and shakes her finger slightly as a reminder.

tomas.frase: Consígueme una cuadrilla más barata. Para mañana.
tomas.accion: He talks on his phone, leaning back with his feet on the desk.

tomas.frase: ¿Nos está corriendo a una semana de entregar?
tomas.accion: He stands in the trailer doorway holding his hard hat.

tomas.frase: Ustedes ya cumplieron. Los nuevos cobran la mitad.
tomas.accion: He signs a paper without looking at them.

tomas.frase: El muro del lobby todavía no lleva el refuerzo.
tomas.accion: He steps forward and taps the blueprint on the desk.

tomas.frase: Ese ya no es su problema. Recojan sus cosas.
tomas.accion: He points at the door with his pen.

tomas.frase: Con el cemento no se juega, arquitecto. Usted sabrá.
tomas.accion: He puts his trowel in his tool belt and turns to leave.

tomas.frase: ¿Refuerzo? A mí nadie me dijo nada, jefe.
tomas.accion: He shrugs, holding a paint roller.

tomas.frase: Tú nomás píntalo y que se vea bonito.
tomas.accion: He waves his hand at the wall while checking his watch.

tomas.frase: Arquitecto, este muro tiene una grieta de arriba abajo.
tomas.accion: He runs his finger along a long crack in the white wall.

tomas.frase: Es la pintura nada más. Es superficial.
tomas.accion: He laughs nervously and adjusts his collar.

tomas.frase: No es pintura. Esto no aguanta ni un temblor.
tomas.accion: He taps the wall with a small rubber mallet and a chunk of concrete falls to the floor.

tomas.frase: ¿Quién hizo esta parte de la obra?
tomas.accion: She turns slowly toward the architect.

tomas.frase: Nosotros, licenciada. Nos dijeron que nomás pintáramos.
tomas.accion: He hides the paint roller behind his back.

tomas.frase: ¿Y dónde está la cuadrilla que hizo todo lo demás?
tomas.accion: She steps closer to the architect.

tomas.frase: Los tuve que dejar ir, licenciada.
tomas.accion: He looks down, sweating, sunglasses in his hand.

tomas.frase: Entonces el contrato también lo dejo ir yo.
tomas.accion: She hands him back the leather folder and walks away.

tomas.frase: Don Chuy, me dijeron que esa estructura la levantó usted.
tomas.accion: She arrives at the small site, stepping around a wheelbarrow.

tomas.frase: Con estas manos y con este muchacho, licenciada.
tomas.accion: He wipes his hands on a rag and puts a hand on the young worker's shoulder.

tomas.frase: La obra nueva es suya. Ponga usted el precio.
tomas.accion: She offers a handshake.

tomas.frase: Ándale, Pedro. Esta vez el extra lo cobramos nosotros.
tomas.accion: He shakes her hand and smiles at the young worker beside him.
